source: Poisson arrivals at rate lambda into a batch of size n: the k-th item of a batch waits for the n - k later arrivals, mean (n - k)/lambda, so the mean over the batch is (n - 1)/(2 lambda) = 4/(2 x 1/60 per second) = 120 s (2 min); docs/research/spec-2-benchmark-sources.md
Batching and unbatching lose no item, so the sink passes the arrival rate: lambda = 1/60 per second (60 per hour)
